must_preserve: round hollow knots and spotted bark texture
subtle warm ocher-gray wash on the wood

motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left to center midground network of smaller bare saplings and shrubs emerging from the snowy bank, including the long low branch stretching horizontally and the delicate twig lattice.
must_preserve: small dark nodes at branch joints
sparse reed-like strokes at the base

motifs.name: snowy_river_terraces
motifs.description: Isolate the layered snow-covered riverbank and water terrace shapes across the lower half, including the long pale landforms, dark under-wash shadows, and gently curving shoreline contours. Exclude tree trunks, rocks, and boat details except where the bank outline passes behind them.
must_preserve: dark gray shadow bands beneath bank edges
soft transitions between snow and water
thin ink outlines on ridge edges
layered recession from foreground to midground

motifs.name: foreground_rocks_on_snow
motifs.description: Isolate the scattered rounded stones and pebble clusters along the very bottom snowy foreground, including the darker shadows beneath them and the larger central-right snow-capped rock group.
must_preserve: gray wash modeling on stone faces
pale snow caps and reserved highlights
dry-brush texture along the bottom edge
